snippet.title: Ordinary Suspects - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Announcement Trailer for Ordinary Suspects, an online social-deception shooter for up to 12 players. Blend into a crowd of identical NPCs, identify your friends, and eliminate them. Make one wrong move and you’ll be exposed.

Ordinary Suspects is coming soon to PC (Steam) - WISHLIST NOW 

#OrdinarySuspects #Gaming #IGN
